fixtureNotice: SYNTHETIC AUTOMATED TESTS ONLY — invented identities and ratings; no observed football dataset.
interpretation: Broad original model design targets, not empirical calibration or validation against observed football. Confidence intervals describe these deterministic synthetic batches; targets are not fitted to real leagues.

fixtureModel.familiarity: Every outfield fixture is familiar with every outfield position; keepers are familiar with GK. Formation comparisons isolate shape rather than unfamiliar assignments.
fixtureModel.instructions: Balanced mentality, standard tempo/width/pressing/defensive line unless the scenario explicitly changes pressing.

sample.pairing: Each scenario reuses the identical explicit seed vector. Odd uint32 multiplication spreads adjacent source indices across RNG states; comparison intervals use per-seed paired differences. Balanced strength estimates average the two orientations within each seed block before computing uncertainty.

outcomes.target: Mean total goals 2–4.5; at least 85% of matches total 0–6 goals; goal standard deviation at least 1. These are broad original design targets.
Draw rate 10–40%; both home and away can win (home >20%, away >15%).
Mean total fouls 5–40, yellow cards 0.2–8, red cards ≤0.3; abandonments ≤0.5%.
Enabling home advantage 0.04 increases the home expected-goal margin by at least 0.05; paired 95% interval excludes zero.
Skill 15 versus 9, balanced across home/away at a neutral venue: goal margin ≥0.6 and win rate ≥58%; seed-block 95% intervals exclude zero goal edge and 50% wins.
Skill 13 versus 11, balanced across home/away at a neutral venue: goal margin ≥0.3 and win rate ≥52%; seed-block 95% intervals exclude zero goal edge and 50% wins.
Starting condition 55 versus 100 reduces expected-goal margin by at least 0.2; paired 95% interval excludes zero.
Stamina 18 versus 6 retains at least three final outfield condition points; paired lower 95% bound ≥3.
High versus low press costs ≥2 condition and ≥0.3 fouls, with increased tackles won (≥0.5) or possession (≥1 percentage point); paired 95% intervals exclude zero.

Higher home chance output at the cost of higher opposition chance output. Both predeclared benefit and cost require paired lower 95% bounds above zero. Win rate 15–70% and loss rate ≥15%.
